subject: Post-demo: payment onboarding sprint & PO/card thresholds
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@soltera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: payment onboarding sprint & PO/card thresholds

Thanks again for taking the demo today, Hannah — appreciated the candid procurement context. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can make the payment path decision before pilot kickoff.

Summary of today's call
- Goal: 8-week pilot (50 seats, API ingest) with production cutover contingent on AP onboarding.
- Main constraint: Soltera's AP requires vendor packets + either a PO for commitments over $25k or a corporate card for < $25k spend.
- Marketplace interest: Engineering asked if Redwood is available via AWS Marketplace — that would simplify SSO and vendor onboarding if true.

Open questions we promised to follow up on
1) Confirm whether procurement will accept a PO on a 30-day net payment term for the pilot.
2) Which internal contact should we loop in for vendor packet and W-9?
3) Is there any marketplace listing / procurement portal preference (AWS/GCP/Microsoft)?

Attached: initial SOW draft and pricing worksheet for the pilot (estimates only).

Proposed next steps
- I will share the SOW + a clean PO template you can use if procurement prefers PO (attached).
- If card is needed for an initial low-dollar POC, we can price a 4-week trial rate and reduce onboarding friction.
- Can we get procurement contact + expected PO turnaround time by EOD Wednesday?

If helpful, we can also run a short procurement enablement call (15–20m) with your AP team to walk the vendor packet and clarify invoice cadence.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Soltera_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), Pricing_Worksheet_Soltera.xlsx (estimate)

From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@soltera.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@soltera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: payment onboarding sprint & PO/card thresholds

Hi Naomi — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- For pilot commitments that are expected to exceed $25k over the contract period, procurement prefers a PO on Net 30. For anything below $25k they will accept card.
- We require a completed vendor packet + standard W-9 (US entity) before we can issue a PO. Our AP team flags incomplete packets which delays PO issuance.
- AWS Marketplace would indeed simplify things but we are not limited to it — the marketplace path only helps if Redwood can accept an AWS Marketplace purchase (including the AWS billing flow).

Action items from our side
- I will share the vendor packet template and our W-9 request with the Procurement Team this afternoon.
- Estimated PO turnaround is ~7–10 business days once a clean packet + SOW are received and legal has scanned the terms. If the SOW matches our standard terms we can be faster.

Procurement contact: procurement@soltera.com (you can copy me personally: hannah.li@soltera.com).

Happy to jump on the procurement enablement call — Wednesdays after 11am PT work best for our AP lead.

Thanks,
Hannah Li
Head of Partnerships | Soltera Systems
Hannah.li@soltera.com

On Mon, Aug 9, 2026 at 3:20 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the demo today, Hannah — appreciated the candid procurement context...

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@soltera.com>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@soltera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: payment onboarding sprint & PO/card thresholds

Hi Hannah / procurement — looping in our commercial lead (Marissa) and finance ops (Karthik) to help speed the packet and SOW review.

Attached two items per request: 1) SOW (final-draft) that aligns to the pilot described; 2) a compact pricing worksheet with pilot line items and expected invoicing cadence. Both are marked as "Draft for procurement review."

Quick notes to help procurement triage: 
- Legal: Redwood uses standard MSAs for enterprise deals; the pilot SOW references our standard commercial terms. If you have specific redlines we can accept with a quick review, please flag them up front — smaller redlines are often workable without a full legal turnaround.
- Invoicing cadence: We can invoice monthly for the pilot. Preferred payment methods we support: PO (Net 30), ACH (bank transfer), and corporate card.
- Marketplace: Redwood is not yet listed on AWS Marketplace for this SKU; we can discuss a marketplace path later but it will not help the next 2–3 weeks.

Next steps (proposed)
1) Procurement to send completed vendor packet + W-9 to procurement@soltera.com (copy Naomi + Marissa).
2) Redwood to receive PO or card details to issue first invoice; target PO issuance within 7–10 business days after packet receipt.
3) If procurement prefers a quick POC via card, Redwood can issue a scaled 4-week trial invoice to reduce time to start.

Would procurement be available for a short call Wednesday 11am PT to walk the packet?

Best,
Naomi

Attachments: Soltera_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Pricing_Worksheet_Soltera.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Soltera procurement path (PO threshold + next ops steps)

Naomi / Karthik — quick internal note after seeing Hannah's asks: 
- Recommendation: offer both routes but prioritize the PO path since they expect >$25k and that aligns to our revenue recognition. Ask legal to pre-clear the SOW redlines we think they might push (data residency and indemnity caps).
- Ops: Karthik, please prepare a short vendor packet checklist (2–3 bullets) and a completed W-9 to attach when Naomi gets the procurement email. That will reduce back-and-forth.
- Marketplace: deprioritize for pilot; tag as Q4 work for our marketplace enablement team.

I'll stand by for intro to procurement lead on Wednesday call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Commercial Lead, Enterprise Sales
marissa.cole@redwood.com
